clue.text: 100 watering holes secreting a mineral

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: to secrete is to hide away, so the drinking places keep the next word tucked inside them

parts.note: an inn is a place to drink, a watering hole
a bar is another place to drink, a second watering hole

explanation.surface: A hundred pubs are said to be hiding a mineral deposit.
explanation.walkthrough: One phrase, 'watering holes', supplies two drinking places; 'secreting' tucks the A between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinnabar is mercury sulphide, a red ore and so a mineral.

clue.text: Poet shrink-wraps piano

indicators.note: the word for shrinking is wrapped round the next piece, enclosing it

parts.note: to shrink back in fear is to cower
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A poet uses cling film to wrap up a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: William Cowper was an eighteenth-century English poet, author of hymns and The Task.

clue.text: Nation absolutely not bearing right

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so the refusal phrase carries the letter for right within it

parts.note: 'no way!' is an emphatic refusal

explanation.surface: A country refuses outright to turn to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway is a Scandinavian country, a nation.

clue.text: Come down, or fall sick, catching beastly disorder

indicators.note: catching means taking hold of, so the word for sickness holds the disease abbreviation

parts.note: to ail is to be or fall ill
BSE, mad cow disease, is a disorder of cattle

explanation.surface: Descending a cliff is set against catching an animal disease.
explanation.definitionFit: To abseil is to descend a rock face on a rope, coming down in a controlled way.

clue.text: Kosher position for the chairman?

definitions.meaning: informally kosher means legitimate, honest and open
the chairman of a company sits at the head of, in rank above, the board of directors

explanation.definitionFit: Above board means honest and open, and literally names a place over a board of directors.

clue.text: Complain about swallowing ounce of sedative

indicators.note: the reversed word swallows the next piece, taking it inside
about means turned round, so the word for complaining is read backwards

parts.note: to carp is to complain

explanation.surface: Someone moans about taking a measure of a calming drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives PRAC, and 'swallowing' takes the ounce abbreviation inside. Prozac is strictly an antidepressant, loosely called a sedative.
explanation.definitionFit: Prozac is a brand of fluoxetine, a calming mood drug, loosely a sedative.

clue.text: Orchestrated hoodlums assembled near tomb

indicators.note: assembled means put together, so these letters are built into a new order

explanation.surface: Thugs gather close to a grave.
explanation.definitionFit: A rent-a-mob is a crowd hired to make trouble, an organised gang of hoodlums.

clue.text: Coiled python not entirely stifled by girl with sponge, perhaps

indicators.note: to be stifled by is to be smothered inside, so the girl's name surrounds the rest

parts.note: Zoe is a girl's name

indicators.note: a coiled snake is twisted round, so its letters are twisted into a new order
not entirely means one letter short, so the snake's word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A girl smothers a snake that is wound up around her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' leaves PYTHO; 'Coiled' rearranges that to OPHYT; 'stifled by' puts it inside the girl's name. 'sponge, perhaps' signals an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A zoophyte is an animal that looks like a plant, and a sponge is one example.

clue.text: Catcher of STD? Nonsense!

parts.note: the clap is slang for gonorrhoea, a sexually transmitted disease
a trap catches things

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at the idea of a device for catching venereal disease.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'a trap for the clap', the order is reversed to make CLAP then TRAP.
explanation.definitionFit: Claptrap is empty talk or rubbish, a synonym for nonsense.

clue.text: Hospital in Nottinghamshire town provides learning experience

indicators.note: the hospital letter sits in the town's name

parts.note: Worksop is a town in Nottinghamshire, England
H is the abbreviation for hospital on signs and maps

explanation.surface: A hospital in an East Midlands town offers a training course.
explanation.walkthrough: WORKSOP is a market town in Nottinghamshire, in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A workshop is a session of practical training, an experience in which people learn.

clue.text: Rabbit (or goat) in slang (or argot)

indicators.note: in means the answer lies within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A slang word for a rabbit or a goat is offered, in argot.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run through 'slANG OR Argot', ignoring the brackets.
explanation.definitionFit: Angora is a breed of both rabbit and goat, prized for their long soft wool.

clue.text: Candidate planting a dangerous device in river

indicators.note: the explosive is planted in the river's name

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, England
a mine is an explosive device

explanation.surface: Someone plants a bomb in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The EXE is a river in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: An examinee is a candidate sitting a test.

clue.text: Distinctive sign of suffering in court

indicators.note: the pain word goes in the court abbreviation

parts.note: an ache is pain, suffering

explanation.surface: A tell-tale mark of pain is shown in a law court.
explanation.definitionFit: A cachet is a distinguishing mark or seal, so a sign of quality or prestige.

clue.text: Artist and soldier in turn following incomplete travelling band

indicators.note: following means this piece comes after the band's word
incomplete means missing its end, so the band's word loses its last letter

parts.note: a caravan is a company of people travelling together

indicators.note: the soldier sits in the word for a turn

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A painter and a soldier take turns after a group of travellers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incomplete' drops the last letter of the band; 'in' makes GGIO; 'following' puts that after the shortened band.
explanation.definitionFit: Caravaggio was an Italian Baroque painter, an artist.

clue.text: Reversal of crime involves time with a society devoted to it

definitions.text: Reversal of crime involves time with a society devoted to it

indicators.note: reversal says the whole string that follows is read backwards
involves means includes, so the crime word takes the time letter inside

parts.note: arson, setting fire to property, is a crime

explanation.surface: A gang that undoes a crime takes time with a society given over to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involves' gives ARTSON; 'Reversal of' turns ARTSON plus A plus the society abbreviation backwards. Read whole, the clue describes the Mafia, a society devoted to crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosa Nostra, 'our thing', is the Sicilian-American Mafia, a criminal society.

clue.text: Sergeant arranged divorce

indicators.note: arranged means set out afresh, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A sergeant arranges a divorce.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange is to separate or alienate, as in a separated spouse, so to divorce.

clue.text: Redolent of corporal punishment

definitions.meaning: redolent of means suggestive of, carrying a trace of
slapping a child is physical punishment

explanation.definitionFit: Smacking of means suggesting, and a smacking is a slap given as punishment.

clue.text: Common, if daring, exploit

indicators.note: to exploit is to work or use, so the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Something common is described as a bold adventure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploit' looks like a noun, a daring deed, but here it is the verb telling you to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Infra dig, short for Latin infra dignitatem, means beneath one's dignity, so vulgar or common.

clue.text: Bird in type of opera given name of student

indicators.note: the bird goes in the type of opera

parts.note: opera seria is serious eighteenth-century opera
the mina, or myna, is an Asian starling

explanation.surface: A bird in an opera is given a student's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A seminarian is a student at a seminary, training for the priesthood.

clue.text: Notice of divorcee's return

indicators.note: return means come back, so the name is read backwards

parts.note: in the film Kramer vs Kramer, the Kramers are a divorcing couple

explanation.surface: A notice tells of a divorced person coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: The divorcee is Kramer, from the 1979 film Kramer vs Kramer.
explanation.definitionFit: A remark is a comment, and to remark is to notice, so a notice.

clue.text: Crack troops dance and walk with a wiggle

parts.note: the SAS is the British special forces regiment
a hay, or hey, is an old country dance

explanation.surface: Elite soldiers dance and swagger.
explanation.walkthrough: The SAS (Special Air Service) is a British special forces unit.
explanation.definitionFit: To sashay is to walk in a showy, hip-swinging way.

clue.text: Call for many to get called up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the whole string is read from bottom to top

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
named means called

explanation.surface: A crowd of people demand to be summoned.
explanation.walkthrough: D and NAMED make DNAMED; 'up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To demand is to call for something forcefully.

clue.text: Novelist runs into road — it's unprecedented

indicators.note: the novelist and runs go into the road abbreviation

parts.note: Umberto Eco was an Italian novelist
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A novelist runs into the road in a way never seen before.
explanation.walkthrough: ECO followed by R goes into RD.
explanation.definitionFit: A record figure is one never achieved before, so unprecedented.

clue.text: Co-nominee, almost bare, seizing high ground

indicators.note: seizing means grabbing, so the shortened word takes the hill inside
almost means short of the end, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: naked means bare
a mesa is a flat-topped hill

explanation.surface: A fellow nominee, nearly naked, grabs the high ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts NAKED to NAKE, which seizes MESA.
explanation.definitionFit: A namesake shares one's name, someone nominated by the same name.

clue.text: New epidemic swamping Austria with larvae

indicators.note: swamping means engulfing, so the disease surrounds the country's letter

parts.note: AIDS has spread as an epidemic
A is the international vehicle code for Austria

explanation.surface: A new disease sweeps through Austria along with grubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Naiads are the aquatic young of mayflies and dragonflies, a kind of larvae.

clue.text: Loss of literacy in a former monarch leading nursemaid round pub

parts.note: GR, Georgius Rex, is King George

indicators.note: the nanny goes round the pub abbreviation

parts.note: an aia, or ayah, is a nanny in India
PH is the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: Illiteracy in an old king who led a nanny round a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: AIA is an Indian or South-east Asian nursemaid; PH (public house) is a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Agraphia is a medical condition in which the ability to write is lost.

clue.text: Promise to supply English silver to Spain

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: An undertaking to supply English silver to Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: To engage is to pledge or bind oneself, so to promise.

clue.text: Pretend to keep opener in church? Not true!

indicators.note: keep means hold, so the pretend word holds the rest inside

parts.note: to cod is to hoax or pretend

indicators.note: the key goes in the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a key opens a lock

explanation.surface: Someone pretends to keep an opener in a church, which is false.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' gives CKEYE; 'keep' puts it inside the word for pretend. A wall that is not true is out of line, crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockeyed means askew, so crooked or not true, as a wall out of line is not true.
